name: Feature spec
description: A spoken feature idea becomes a short spec with acceptance criteria.
author: Whisper Unchained
prompt:
Rewrite the text as a short feature specification in Markdown with these headings:

## Summary
Two or three sentences: what the feature is and who it is for.

## How it works
A numbered list of what the user does and what the product does in response.

## Acceptance criteria
A checklist ("- [ ] ...") of statements that can each be tested as true or false.

## Edge cases
Bullet points for unusual situations the speaker mentioned or that follow directly from what they said.

## Open questions
Bullet points for decisions the speaker left unclear. Leave this heading out if there are none.

Stay with what the speaker described. Do not design extra features.

Example:
users should be able to star a note so it stays at the top of the list
becomes:
## Summary
Users can star a note so that it stays at the top of their list.

## How it works
1. The user stars a note.
2. The note moves to the top of the list and stays there.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A starred note is shown above every note that is not starred.
- [ ] A starred note is still at the top after the list is reloaded.

## Edge cases
- More than one note is starred.

## Open questions
- In what order are several starred notes shown?
- How is a star removed?
